newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Securicor raised at BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Securicor raised at BZW.

text.p: Securicor Plc, the security services group that owns a major stake in mobile phone operator Cellnet, was raised to a "buy" from "hold" at BZW, market sources said on Friday.
Sources said BZW set a price target of 320p on the stock, saying it was undervalued compared with other mobile phone companies.
The brokerage also said the stock was attractive because its activities were focused on the UK and therefore was insulated from currency downgrades.
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
The stock was down 2p at 289-1/2 by 1035 GMT.
